name: Bundle of Wood
summary: Near Eastvale Logging Camp, Bundle of Wood waits in the trees for an urgent shipment west.

sections.title: Abandoned Timber
sections.body: Freshly chopped timber from Eastvale Logging Camp helps supply the Kingdom of Stormwind. The camp sends wood west for town buildings and other construction. Bears and wolves have pushed into the groves northwest of camp, and terrified loggers fled, leaving their freshly gathered Bundles of Wood among the trees. With delivery deadlines close, overseer Raelen needs travelers to pass the predators and recover the timber before the lumber contracts are breached.

faq.q: Why were these bundles of wood abandoned in the woods?
faq.answer: Wolves and bears ambushed the loggers harvesting timber northwest of Eastvale Logging Camp and drove them off. Their freshly chopped Bundles of Wood were left scattered on the forest floor.
Raelen, an overseer at Eastvale Logging Camp, urgently needs the wood gathered to meet an impending lumber shipment deadline.
The bundles lie on the ground directly northwest of Eastvale Logging Camp, among the trees where Elwynn's bears and wolves prowl.

faq.q: Why didn't the town guards clear out the beasts?
faq.answer: Raelen asked Deputy Rainer for help with the beasts, but Elwynn's marshals and guards are stretched thin across the region. The lumber workers need outside help to recover the logs quickly.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, gathering the bundles helps Stormwind's rebuilding efforts and gets vital timber shipments to settlements across Elwynn and Westfall on time.
